title: put up $1000 for a jam because half the people i talk to have a game sitting 80% done that they never shipped
author: IamDroBro
selftext:
so i run whim, the marketplace i've posted about here before. quick version if you missed it: you put your AI-built game or app up, people play it in the browser, you keep 90% if you charge for it.



anyway the thing that made me do this: people keep sending me games that are like 80% done and just stopped. not stuck on some hard bug. just stopped, because there was no reason to push it the last bit. no deadline, no one waiting on it.



so here's a reason. $1000 total, $400 best game, $400 best app, $200 people's choice. goes til aug 30. no theme, and you do NOT have to make it during the two weeks. if you've got something half done right now, go finish that. thats the entire point.



free to enter, first listing is free. i only take 10% if you actually sell something and a bunch of people are just listing free so i make nothing off them, which is honestly fine.



its my platform so yeah i want people on it, not gonna pretend im doing this out of pure kindness. but i would genuinely rather these things exist than sit in a folder forever.



[buywhim.com/jam](http://buywhim.com/jam) if you want it. ill be in the comments all week, ask me whatever.

comments.author: WuxiaScrub
comments.body: I just submitted mine! Only one question: is there a way to edit the entry after submission? I noticed that the screenshots that I attached aren't displaying in the order I wanted; not a huge deal but would be nice to be able to rearrange those.

replies.author: IamDroBro
replies.body: yeah you can. go to your dashboard, click your entry, hit edit. scroll to the screenshots section and each one has little up/down arrows to reorder plus an x to remove. edit as much as you want, it updates the live listing right away. glad you're in!

comments.author: SandshrewPoke
comments.body: Might add my game. Good luck!

replies.author: IamDroBro
replies.body: do it! and no pressure on it being polished, half-finished totally counts. give me a shout if you hit any snags getting it up.

comments.author: GrokiniGPT
comments.body: Would a Chinese learning app work? That was a long built ap that I made but it's not too much of a game

replies.author: IamDroBro
replies.body: Absolutely!  This is the ai game dev sub so the post is more focused around games, but half of the jam is for general apps as well!  Does not need to be a game!

comments.author: Pretend-Telephone836
comments.body: So if I put my app up on Whim, who retains ownership? Am I secretly signing the rights to my app away? I couldn't find anything in the faq or terms of service

replies.author: IamDroBro
replies.body: you keep everything. you own your app 100%, full stop. whim only gets permission to host it and serve it to people who play or buy it, thats it. no ownership transfer, no resale rights, nothing hidden. it's in the terms ("sellers own their apps") but youre right that its buried in there, so im going to spell it out way clearer on the sell page and in the faq. good question.

comments.author: Fizassist1
comments.body: my educational physics game will take some time.. school year has started (so a lot less free time), and credits are expensive so im working within my weekly codex limits.  very excited to push out what I do have when I can though!

replies.author: IamDroBro
replies.body: no rush at all, that's why the window is two weeks and not 48 hours! even a slice of it by aug 30 counts as a real entry. and "educational physics game" already sounds like something id want to poke at, so take the time it needs.

replies.author: Fizassist1
replies.body: the big part of my game is the "lab" you get to customize.. and that part is pretty much done.  I intend on adding 14+ mini games (at least one for each unit) and I've finished 3 of them.  so I might make a couple more and submit 😊

comments.author: Fringe_Walker_
comments.body:
I'm interested in adding my slice I've created of my game so far, but it's more like the demo of the game vs the full one. Can I launch a demo and add a paid full version later? Backwards I guess than usual? 

Also I'm curious about how many downloads/in browser plays you've had (traffic?) Might be convenient to add a similar count system to entice other creators to add to your launch platform if they see regular/large play/buy counts.

replies.author: IamDroBro
replies.body:
yeah you can do it backwards, thats totally fine! easiest path: list your slice now as a free game so people can actually play it and it starts pulling reviews and plays right away. when the full version is ready you just set a price on that same listing, push the full build as a new version, and mark the slice you already have as the demo. same page, same url, same reviews, nothing resets. so it goes free slice, then paid full with a free demo attached, all on one listing. you only touch the listing fee once and your first one is free anyway.



on counts, creators already get the full picture in their dashboard: plays, views, sales and earnings per app. publicly a listing shows a favorites count and flips to a "X users" badge once enough people have bought it, so theres social proof without slapping a big fat 0 on everything brand new. showing play counts publicly a little earlier is a good shout though, im adding it to the list.



still early days on traffic but its growing week over week. happy to share specifics if youre thinking of putting your game up, just dm me. and if you list before aug 30 it drops into the jam automatically

replies.author: Fringe_Walker_
replies.body:
Ima polish my slice a little more. 

Work on the NPC to make it less predictable. But I think I'll post it in a few days given the time. Just signed my contract to join the army, ship out mid October, so I'd like to try to launch 2 games on your platform and see what I can rack up while im away for training.

comments.author: Weary_Substance_2199
comments.body: Games 80% done, but stuck on game breaking bugs. This right here describes perfectly vibe coding. Good luck debugging spaghetti code written by AI, especially when you don't understand coding at that level.

comments.author: Zenity07
comments.body: Is this platform specifically for games that run in the browser?

replies.author: IamDroBro
replies.body: nope! it can also be a general app, and the creator can choose whether or not they want the file to be downloadable

replies.author: Zenity07
replies.body: Downloadable is a zip archive / regular file upload? Any file size limit?

replies.author: IamDroBro
replies.body:
yeah it's just a regular file upload, whatever you want, a zip, an exe, a pdf, source, doesn't matter. limit there is 1gb.



that's separate from the browser-playable path btw. if you want it to run instantly in the browser, that's a single html file or a zip bundle up to 50mb. and you can do both on the same listing, play it in the browser AND offer the download.

comments.author: Viktorkin
comments.body: If I decide to unlist my game from the site later - any issues with that?

comments.author: BeltwayBro
comments.body: Looks cool! Thanks for sharing. Is the $400 actual prize money or is that the monetary value of the 4 weeks of premium listing?
